collection.description: Someone from a neighboring group is accused of taking fruit, but the evidence is uncertain.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Someone from a neighboring group is accused of taking fruit, but the evidence is uncertain.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Tracks reveal an animal caused much of the damage.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The investigation finds wrongdoing by someone unexpected.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The accused group protests the accusation.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Repayment is arranged, though resentment remains.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The offer eases hunger and prevents further theft.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some villagers resent sharing food without an explanation.
